Synthesis:
Guarantees: (1) Admit validates scope via self.validate() and capacity; two paths (contracts/sandboxes) use locks/state checks. (2) Retire blocks on session roots, pins (line 656), and active task usage. (3) expected_version enforces integer-only CAS; conflicts return current_version for caller-managed retries. (4) retention_until_tasks_complete tracks readers+writers until completion.
Limitations: (1) self.validate() logic is encapsulated/unauditable here. (2) Pin check has a race window (no post-check blocking). (3) No built-in retry for version conflicts.
Test Proposal: Concurrent retire vs. pin test. Thread A calls retire(obj), Thread B calls pin(obj). Verify atomicity: does the lock prevent retiring while pin is being registered? Expect failure if race allows retire to pass before pin check completes.
